trump administration.name: The Trump administration
trump administration.angle: judged on results, not on which side he is on: not pro-market, not pro-free-speech, and foreign policy is the worst of it.

china.name: China
china.angle: genuinely innovative and forward-looking, and simultaneously in real economic trouble

immigration.name: Free trade and immigration
immigration.angle: unilateral free trade pays whoever adopts it, and skilled immigrants grow the pie rather than take a slice of it

free speech.name: Free speech and government power over media and speech
free speech.angle: an FCC licence review or an FTC bias rule is censorship whichever party writes it

tucker carlson the maga right.name: Trump and the MAGA right
tucker carlson the maga right.angle: judged on results and on principle, and by that test the right is as statist as the left

capitalism versus the mixed economy.name: Capitalism versus the mixed economy
capitalism versus the mixed economy.angle: we have never had capitalism, only a mixed economy drifting toward statism, and the problems people blame on markets trace to specific government policies.

american power abroad.name: American power abroad
american power abroad.angle: perceived weakness is what invites the next war, from Iran to Taiwan

technology and human progress.name: Technology and AI as human progress
technology and human progress.angle: presumptively good and worth defending out loud; the fear is unearned and deregulation, not permission, is the answer

israel antisemitism and the double stand.name: Israel, antisemitism and the double standard
israel antisemitism and the double stand.angle: Israel is held to a standard Russia and Iran are not, and the loudest attacks on it now come from the populist right as much as the left.

debt deficits the fed and inflation.name: Debt, deficits, inflation and the Fed
debt deficits the fed and inflation.angle: spending is the disease, price rises from supply shocks are not monetary inflation, and stagnation is the likeliest ending

tribalism and the collapse of reason.name: Tribalism and the collapse of reason
tribalism and the collapse of reason.angle: woke never died, it changed target, and the same anti-truth loyalty now runs the right too

objectivist ethics altruism against self.name: Objectivist ethics: altruism against self-interest
objectivist ethics altruism against self.angle: the moral premise, not ignorance, is what keeps people reaching for socialism

personal responsibility against corporat.name: Personal responsibility against corporate liability
personal responsibility against corporat.angle: force and fraud are the only grounds for blame; parents, not platforms, raise children

defending capitalism against its critics.name: Defending capitalism against its critics
defending capitalism against its critics.angle: the critics never define the word, they leave the entrepreneur out of the picture, and Marx's exploitation story still sits under nearly all of it

tribalism and the crisis of reason on bo.name: Tribalism and the crisis of reason on both left and right
tribalism and the crisis of reason on bo.angle: woke never left, it changed targets; the vice is caring about loyalty rather than truth, and the right has it too

the human achievement roundup.name: The human achievement roundup
the human achievement roundup.angle: rockets, mRNA vaccines, drones and falling battery prices as the standing evidence that free people and markets deliver

individual and parental responsibility v.name: Individual responsibility
individual and parental responsibility v.angle: companies are liable for force and fraud, not for what people choose to overuse; parents, not platforms or the state, raise children.

ideas drive history.name: Ideas drive history
ideas drive history.angle: Marx is the unacknowledged foundation of almost all talk about capitalism, and bad philosophy travels from journals to podcasts to policy.

art and aesthetics.name: Art and aesthetics
art and aesthetics.angle: judge a work on its own terms and by whether reason is the source of the hero's power, not by fidelity or casting rows

technology and human achievement.name: Technology and human achievement
technology and human achievement.angle: innovation is presumptively good and opposition to it is unearned fear; he ends most shows celebrating what people built this week.

spending entitlements and the fiscal ari.name: Spending, entitlements and the fiscal arithmetic
spending entitlements and the fiscal ari.angle: the deficit is a spending problem, taxes cannot close it, and the gerontocracy transfers wealth from the young because old people vote.

free trade.name: Free trade
free trade.angle: a tariff is a tax paid at home, and unilateral free trade benefits whoever adopts it no matter what the other side does.

nobody is defending capitalism.name: Nobody is defending capitalism
nobody is defending capitalism.angle: the DSA left and the Vance/Tucker right are both statist, so the moral case for markets goes unmade on every platform that matters.

art culture and objectivism.name: Art, culture and Objectivism
art culture and objectivism.angle: he judges a work by whether reason and human agency drive it, and notes how completely Rand is left out of serious treatments of capitalism.
